notes: Clean course, overwhelmingly false positives: 90/133 are sub-gloss slices (role 'component' contextual pieces never drilled bare) and 26 are pure English morphology on the same lemma (to-X/X, friend/friends, what is/what's, a/an, agreement/number). The few genuine fixes are all multi-word build/use sentence pairs where a fuller and a shorter rendering of the SAME Punjabi sentence were both drilled (consolidate to one canonical) plus 4 single-row data errors where an English gloss doesn't match the Punjabi (trying vs want, added 'to say'/'money', 'television here'); none are high-frequency core tokens, so no release blockers.
